title: Import Twitch Follows
intro: You sign in to Twitch in your browser and approve Lurk there. Lurk only reads whom you follow, subscribes to those channels and signs out again right away – Lurk never sees your password.

code.title: Approve Lurk on Twitch
code.text: Open Twitch in your browser, sign in and check that it shows this code. Lurk only asks whom you follow – if Twitch shows other permissions, cancel.
code.label: Your code:
code.waiting_one: Waiting for your approval … The code is valid for {{count}} minute.
code.waiting_other: Waiting for your approval … The code is valid for {{count}} minutes.

confirm.title: Import the follows of @{{login}}?
confirm.text_one: Twitch returned 1 channel. The sign-in at Twitch has already ended.
confirm.text_other: Twitch returned {{number}} channels. The sign-in at Twitch has already ended.

done.known: You were already subscribed to {{number}} of them. The sign-in at Twitch is forgotten.
done.forgotten: The sign-in at Twitch is forgotten.

failed.title: Follows not imported
failed.empty: Twitch returned no follows. Do you follow any channels yet?
failed.denied: The sign-in was declined on Twitch.
